target.title: fix(msteams): normalize inbound mentions and forwards
target.body:
Closes #102376

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Microsoft Teams users would send mentions, quoted replies, or forwarded messages and the agent would receive incomplete or misleading text. Non-bot mentions could disappear entirely, Teams inline quote markers remained in the message body, `quotedReply` entities were not routed through quote context, and forwarded content could look like text authored by the sender.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a Teams-owned inbound normalizer before monitor dispatch. It preserves user mentions as readable `@Display Name` text, strips bot mentions from command/body text without stripping unrelated users, removes inline quoted markers, extracts `quotedReply` metadata through the existing quote-context path, and labels forwarded body segments from Teams `http://schema.skype.com/Forward` HTML blockquotes.

Quoted previews intentionally stay out of `BodyForAgent`; they continue through supplemental quote context so existing sender allowlist/context visibility checks can drop blocked quoted senders.

## User Impact

Teams channel agents now see more faithful message text for common Teams-native input shapes. Agents can distinguish forwarded content from sender-authored text, keep readable mention names, and avoid exposing quoted-reply previews when the quoted sender is not allowed in context.

## Evidence

Before evidence:

```shell
Current-main source proof before this fix:
extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.ts:
  const rawText = activity.text?.trim() ?? "";
  const htmlText = extractTextFromHtmlAttachments(attachments);
  const valueText =
    rawText || htmlText ? "" : serializeMSTeamsAdaptiveCardActionValue(activity.value);
  const text = stripMSTeamsMentionTags(rawText || htmlText || valueText || "");

extensions/msteams/src/inbound.ts:
  export function stripMSTeamsMentionTags(text: string): string {
    // Teams wraps mentions in <at>...</at> tags
    return text.replace(/<at[^>]*>.*?<\/at>/gi, "").trim();
  }
```

Azure Crabbox exact-head proof:

```shell
provider=azure
lease=cbx_16d4a1c8b55c
slug=crimson-shrimp
remote_workdir=/work/crabbox/cbx_16d4a1c8b55c/fresh-pr-openclaw-openclaw-102379
head=154ed0faf5473be7f46f62840726c7bab8a903ea

$ pnpm test extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.authz.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       64 passed (64)

AFTER_FIX_BODY_FOR_AGENT="@Example User One see this\n\n[Forwarded message]\nthe forwarded body text\n[/Forwarded message]"
AFTER_FIX_QUOTE_CONTEXT={"sender":"Ryan Gregg (test)","body":"the original message text","senderId":"sender-aad"}
AFTER_FIX_BLOCKED_QUOTE_BODY="Current message"
AFTER_FIX_BLOCKED_QUOTE_EXPECTATION={"supplementalContext":{},"reason":"quotedReply senderId is filtered by existing allowlist/context visibility path"}

$ corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions
# passed

$ OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
# passed
```

Autoreview:

```shell
$ .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.82)
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed**: Microsoft Teams inbound mention, quoted-reply, and forwarded-message payloads are normalized before the agent receives text.
- **Real environment tested**: Azure Crabbox fresh PR checkout on Linux, provider `azure`, lease `cbx_16d4a1c8b55c`, slug `crimson-shrimp`, remote workdir `/work/crabbox/cbx_16d4a1c8b55c/fresh-pr-openclaw-openclaw-102379`. The run asserted exact PR head `154ed0faf5473be7f46f62840726c7bab8a903ea`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```shell
crabbox run --provider azure --id crimson-shrimp --reclaim --fresh-pr openclaw/openclaw#102379 --shell -- '<fresh PR checkout; assert head; install if needed; run focused Teams tests; print normalization proof lines; run extension type lanes>'

pnpm test extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.authz.test.ts
node --import tsx --input-type=module -e '<imports buildMSTeamsNormalizedText/extractMSTeamsQuoteInfo and prints AFTER_FIX_* proof lines>'
corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions
OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
```

- **Evidence after fix**:

```shell
CRABBOX_PHASE:context
/work/crabbox/cbx_16d4a1c8b55c/fresh-pr-openclaw-openclaw-102379
154ed0faf5473be7f46f62840726c7bab8a903ea

Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       64 passed (64)

AFTER_FIX_BODY_FOR_AGENT="@Example User One see this\n\n[Forwarded message]\nthe forwarded body text\n[/Forwarded message]"
AFTER_FIX_QUOTE_CONTEXT={"sender":"Ryan Gregg (test)","body":"the original message text","senderId":"sender-aad"}
AFTER_FIX_BLOCKED_QUOTE_BODY="Current message"
AFTER_FIX_BLOCKED_QUOTE_EXPECTATION={"supplementalContext":{},"reason":"quotedReply senderId is filtered by existing allowlist/context visibility path"}

CRABBOX_PHASE:tsgo_extensions
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions.tsbuildinfo

CRABBOX_PHASE:tsgo_extensions_test
$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/extensions-test.tsbuildinfo

CRABBOX_PHASE:done
run summary sync=23.456s command=40.669s total=1m4.125s sync_skipped=false exit=0
```

- **Observed result after fix**: The focused Teams tests passed with coverage for mention display-name preservation, bot mention stripping, quoted marker removal, `quotedReply` supplemental context, blocked quoted sender filtering, and forwarded-body labeling. The direct proof command shows the agent-facing body is normalized to `@Example User One see this` plus an explicit forwarded-message block, quote metadata is extracted from `quotedReply`, and the blocked quote body remains `Current message`. Both extension TypeScript lanes passed on the same Azure fresh PR checkout.
- **What was not tested**: I did not run a live Microsoft Teams tenant capture/replay because no private Teams credentials or live session were available in this environment. The proof is exact-head Azure Crabbox behavior over the Teams inbound normalizer and monitor-handler seams with sanitized Teams-shaped payloads.
